description: This file implements a watch mode loop for running and managing tests in the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes and functions for handling test server communication, user input, and command processing during test execution.

classes.name: InMemoryTransport
classes.description: A class implementing a transport mechanism for test server communication, using EventEmitter to handle message passing.

methods.name: runWatchModeLoop
methods.description: Main function to run the test watch mode loop, handling test execution, user commands, and test file changes.

methods.name: readKeyPress
methods.description: Utility to read key presses from stdin and handle commands or interrupts.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Function to initiate test runs with specified options and handle user interruption.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Function to read user commands from stdin, mapping key presses to command strings.

methods.name: printConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs the current test run configuration and command options.

methods.name: printBufferPrompt
methods.description: Displays prompt when in buffer mode, indicating changed files.

methods.name: printPrompt
methods.description: Displays waiting prompt for user input.

methods.name: toggleShowBrowser
methods.description: Toggles the visibility and reuse of the browser during tests.
